mapper.select: SELECT * FROM simulated_provider_fault WHERE remaining > 0 AND ( (match_attempt_key IS NOT NULL AND match_attempt_key = #{attemptKey}) OR (match_attempt_key IS NULL AND match_user_id IS NOT NULL AND match_user_id = #{userId} AND (match_application_id IS NULL OR match_application_id = #{applicationId})) OR (match_attempt_key IS NULL AND match_user_id IS NULL AND match_application_id IS NOT NULL AND match_application_id = #{applicationId}) OR (match_attempt_key IS NULL AND match_user_id IS NULL AND match_application_id IS NULL) ) ORDER BY (match_attempt_key IS NOT NULL) DESC, (match_user_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM simulated_provider_fault WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE simulated_provider_fault SET remaining = remaining - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining > 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM simulated_provider_job WHERE attempt_key = #{attemptKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE simulated_provider_job SET state = #{state}, terminal_at = NOW(3), result_ref = #{resultRef}, result_digest = #{resultDigest}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_detail = #{failureDetail}, query_failures_remaining = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND complete_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE simulated_provider_job SET query_failures_remaining = query_failures_remaining - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND query_failures_remaining > 0
UPDATE simulated_provider_job SET state = 'CANCELLED', terminal_at = NOW(3), query_failures_remaining = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING'
